meta.title: Knockout configuration: offer basis, starting price, tick size, time difference

steps.note: Start the eRFX flow used to reach RFQ-to-Auction conversion.
Create an RFQ, which is the required source event for a Knockout auction.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the required product line for the auction.
Commit a valid schedule so the RFQ can be published.
Add a participant required for publishing.
Publish the RFQ so it can be converted.
Verify the RFQ reached a real published project page.
Open the converted-auction create screen where Knockout configuration is available.

args.goal: On the converted auction create screen, select the Knockout strategy, choose either Best Price or Total Amount as the offer basis, enter valid starting price, tick size, and time difference values, save the configuration, and verify all four configured settings are visibly retained before publishing.

steps.note: Configure and verify the four Knockout settings that have no dedicated catalog step.
Confirm the configured converted-auction screen remains available for publishing after the settings are saved.
